title: The Tax Notice
intro: An email says you owe tax and a penalty will be added unless you pay through a link today.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Final notice: unpaid tax. Pay now.

subject.text: FINAL NOTICE: unpaid tax, pay now

p.text: A penalty of $200 will be added at midnight.
Failure to pay may lead to legal action and arrest.

addr.label: Not an official address
addr.lens: It comes from civic-revenue-pay.com, not a government address.
addr.why: Government offices do not send payment requests from addresses like this.

penalty.label: Penalty at midnight
penalty.why: A hard deadline stops you thinking.

link.label: A "pay now" link
link.lens: The button goes to a payment page that is not official.
link.why: Pay taxes only on the official site you type yourself.

arrest.label: "Legal action and arrest"
arrest.lens: A threat of arrest over a bill.

greet.label: "Dear Taxpayer"
greet.why: Vague greetings are common, but not proof of a scam alone.

amount.label: A specific amount
amount.why: A specific number can be invented.

actions.label: Check my tax account on the official website I type myself

trap.title: Civic Revenue · Pay
trap.ask: Enter your card number to pay $642.30 and avoid the penalty.

block_report.line: Reported as phishing and deleted. The fake address was blocked.

verify.line: Your official tax account showed nothing owed. The email was fake. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The page copied your card details. The "tax" was never owed, and the charges kept coming.

what_if.go_ahead: Your official account would have shown nothing owed. Government offices do not threaten arrest by email.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Check any tax bill on the official website you type yourself. Never pay through an email link.

quick_check.q: An email says you owe tax and will be arrested unless you pay through a link. What do you do?

options.text: Do not click. Check on the official website you type yourself, and report it

quick_check.explain: Fear is the lure. Your real account shows the truth.

hints.nudge: Look at the address the email really came from.

rows.v: Ends in .gov or the official domain

rows.k: Do government offices threaten arrest by email?

rows.v: Use the official site you type yourself
